name: Rizuhble's Round 'Em Up Holliday
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Powder Keg T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Rapid Recharge. Ultimate (Spirit Lasso) is available from Rapid Recharge.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Powder Keg (2 to 3).

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary, sold when you buy Spirit Burn later.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 11.2 to Crackshot's damage (1.12x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 20.1 to Crackshot's damage (1.12x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Adds 1 more charge to Powder Keg (4 to 5), Bounce Pad (2 to 3). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-21,600 (levels 14-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Spirit Lasso T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Crackshot, damage) grows from 145 to 221. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Powder Keg (146), Crackshot (135) clear its 80-damage trigger.

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Spirit Lasso: its duration-scaled parts (duration 3s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,800 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Spirit Lasso duration (3s), Bounce Pad duration (22s), Crackshot bullet resist reduction duration (5s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Powder Keg: takes 18% off its 18s base cooldown.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 33.5 to Crackshot's damage (1.12x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 14,400 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 159s; 20% off is 31.8s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 28,000-48,800 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bounce Pad T3, Crackshot T3.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 6.4k vitality in 2400.0 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage.
items.legacy_note: Curse them right before you lasso.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Recharging Rush.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Recharging Rush.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slowing Hex early, Disarming Hex later.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry dives you when you land.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Spirit Lasso gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (90s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On Powder Keg. Sell Recharging Rush for this.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 12 to 54% weapon damage. Replaces Recharging Rush: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Recharging Rush for this, or Rapid Recharge if it's gone.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 159s of base cooldown across your kit, 90s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Stamina Mastery: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
